prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1004; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was turning left at an intersection in Houston, Texas, when a vehicle coming the other way struck the front of my car. I had the green light and was moving slowly into the turn when the impact threw me against my seatbelt. I have been the named driver on this policy for several years, and I have kept my coverage current throughout. Since the collision I have told the same account every time I have spoken with the adjuster, the police officer at the scene, and the medical staff who examined me. My right shoulder was hurt in the impact and has been painful to lift or reach across my body. I am seeking a physical therapy evaluation and treatment for the injury and reimbursement for the damage to my vehicle. I am happy to provide photographs, the repair estimate, and any other records you need to process this claim.
